name: Fear Godly
overview: Scripture emphasizes the fear of the LORD as a vital attitude in the lives of God's people, urging judges and leaders to act faithfully and with a perfect heart, recognizing that they serve the LORD in their judgments (2 Chronicles 19:6-9). This reverent fear is portrayed as a pursuit akin to seeking hidden treasures or silver, highlighting its value and the diligent effort required to attain true understanding (Proverbs 2:3-4). Together, these verses reveal that fearing God involves careful obedience, unwavering integrity, and a heartfelt desire for wisdom that honors Him in all decisions.
